CustomField.description: When a new value is added to National Account Type on Asset (Asset.National_Account_Type__c), make sure to update this formula and the formula for Case National Account Type (Case. National_Account_Type__c).
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK( TEXT(pse__Account__r.WO_Asset__r.National_Account_Type__c) ) , null , CASE( TEXT(pse__Account__r.WO_Asset__r.National_Account_Type__c) , '82005' , 'Broker' , '82004' , 'Franchise' , '82006' , 'Private Capital Markets' , '82007' , 'Other' , TEXT(pse__Account__r.WO_Asset__r.National_Account_Type__c) ) )
CustomField.label: National Account Type
